name: driver-porting
description: Driver porting and review: the clean-room pipeline (os-investigator, cleanroom-spec, cleanroom-implementer), source-anchored specs and reference reviews for code you own, board specs and the board-expert reader, the Raspberry Pi 5, Raspberry Pi 4 and Rockchip RK3588 board experts, a scaffold for writing new board specs, and a spec verifier that re-derives any spec's claims from the sources it cites.
